title: CLO/MD LiveSync is on Fab — Now with macOS Support!
content:
We are thrilled to announce that [**CLO/MD LiveSync is now available on Fab.com**](https://www.fab.com/listings/e1ecc882-d6c4-4928-b880-5f66d1590bba)! This means you'll be able to download LiveSync and update to newer versions directly through the Epic Games Launcher, without needing to manually place the plugin in the engine folder. **With this update, you can now use CLO/MD LiveSync on macOS as well**! 🚀

You can get it by navigating to the listing and clicking 'Add to My Library' after signing in. Then, you can find it by searching for 'LiveSync' in Library > Fab Library on the Epic Games Launcher. **Please note that this is available for Unreal Engine 5.6 and later versions**.

![7d66e68daab7461cb7e370a02585d8aa](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/c68de71f63fa47bb9464917bc07a9e95/images/7d66e68daab7461cb7e370a02585d8aaUntitled-1.jpg)

![b398547db6eb47a09ac0f246b434e2dc](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/c68de71f63fa47bb9464917bc07a9e95/images/b398547db6eb47a09ac0f246b434e2dcimage.png)

We are currently working on supporting the new MetaHuman Parametric Body in both CLO and Marvelous Designer, as well as creating a series of tutorial videos for using CLO/MD LiveSync (check out [**the latest updates for MetaHuman in Unreal Engine 5.6**](https://www.metahuman.com/en-US/news/metahuman-leaves-early-access-with-a-feature-packed-new-release)). In the meantime, please refer to [**the existing documentation for LiveSync 2**](https://connect-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/sections/45247124078873-User-guide-for-LiveSync-2). Stay tuned for more updates! 🙂

Best regards,

Bryan![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/c68de71f63fa47bb9464917bc07a9e95/images/8a95bc78dd2a491891621e1cc855274fCLO_LiveSyncPromo_Still_No_Title_Expand.png)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi,I’m using CLO Version 2025.1.240, and the “Enable LiveSync” checkbox is turned on.However, I can’t find the “CLO/MD Live Sync Editor” option under Window in Unreal Engine — it simply doesn’t appear.I’ve tried with Unreal Engine versions 5.5.4 and 5.6.1.I also manually placed the LiveSync plugin underC:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.6\Engine\Plugins\Marketplace and UE_5.5\Engine\Plugins\Marketplace,and for UE 5.6, I additionally tried with install from Fab.The plugin shows up as installed and was enabled under “Plugins”, but the option still doesn’t appear under the Window menu.Could someone please help or advise?Best regards,Anastasia

Comment 2: Starting with CLO 2025.0.324 (Individual), a new LiveSync setting has been introduced that allows users to enable or disable the feature. For more details, please refer to the relevant documentation.For CLO Enterprise and Marvelous Designer, version numbers will be announced once the corresponding patch releases are rolled out.
Reply 1: I can't find in the documentation how to export the fur strand to Unreal properly, or to another software. Can you help me out?
Reply 2: Hi Sofia, exporting the Fur Strand fabric type via LiveSync is identical to the export process for Fur (Render Only) fabric type. The steps can be found in the following documentation: https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/c68de71f63fa47bb9464917bc07a9e95 there are any issues, please let me know so that my team and I can review and resolve them. 🙂
content_description: Announcing the availability of CLO/MD LiveSync on Fab.com for seamless Unreal Engine 5.6+ integration, now supporting macOS with easy download and update via the Epic Games Launcher.

title: Skin without Underwear
content:
I want to create underwear and need to use an avatar without underwear texture to use it for my presentation. I'm not able to change the skin in the newest CLO version. How can I solve this problem? In addition the question: is it possible that the avatars like Feifei can be added back to the default garment avatars? I was always using FeiFei and like to continue using her.

Hope we can find a solution.

Sophie

PS.: In my opinion the new way of reaching the library is not an improvement.

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi There. For the newer Avatars the undergarments can be set to nude, this has been a feature in CLO for several versions now. You can click on the avatar and the go to the Property Editor > Body Styling > Click on the blue head icon to the right on Skin Style > a pop up will open > Change underwear from Covered to NudeAs for older Avatars these will not be added back to to CLO library. But if you wish to continue using FeiFei you can open an old CLO project where you used FeiFei and then go to File > Save As Avatar. You can save FeiFei, just make sure to save to your local computer/sharedirve and not to the CLO program folders as those can be replaced when CLO is updated in the future.Also, keep in mind that FeiFei and older avatars will not have some of the newer features like bust adjustment, soft body, or the above mentioned Skin Style options
content_description: This page aims to provide solutions for customizing avatar textures and restoring favorite avatars like FeiFei in CLO, while addressing user feedback on recent library access changes.
